title: Top Coaching Suggestions
subtitle: Oct 14 Workflow Review. Pick an answer for each, add a note if you like, then Submit.

items.title: Freeze Cleanup First
items.why: Owner: Grok Bot. One overnight list in the 7:18 brief, then the Router back on; test pings and site unlocks stay out of the results inbox.

items.title: One Numbered Dashboard Standard
items.why: Owner: Branding Agent. One numbered standard so dashboard rules stop flip-flopping.

items.title: UpKeep Owns Its Customer Site
items.why: Owner: UpKeep and Grok Bot. Grok Bot hands requests over; every customer-facing approval is logged; passwords stay out of the feed.

items.title: Add Legal To The Org Chart
items.why: Owner: Grok Bot. Split the lawyer work between Legal and WellNest, and finish the three pending agent deletions.

items.title: Morning Reports At 5:00, Checked Automatically
items.why: Owner: Grok Bot and every agent. Settle on 5:00, and every dashboard posts a small report file for automatic on-time checks.
